verdicts.reason: A spreads the headline, striped image and date/address into three separate pieces. The date/address block is tiny, floats far from the headline and is detached from the content it belongs to. The image strip is shrunk to a narrow centre column, and the gaps between elements are uneven, about 200px on one side and 70px on the other. B keeps the headline and details together in one readable block and gives the headline more presence. However, the whole group is boxed into the centre, leaving about 190px of dead white space on each side, so it looks like the original pasted in the middle rather than a layout built for a wide banner. The details also sit a little tight under the headline.
